summary: Executed backend regression (market + observer + demo ledger) and frontend desktop/mobile integration on the public URL. Backend flows passed; one mobile navigation usability defect found.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar route buttons (e.g., nav-signals-button) are present in DOM but rendered with 0x0 hit area on 390x844, so navigation from Home sidebar is not interactable on mobile.

action_items: Fix mobile Home sidebar route buttons so they have visible/clickable bounds on 390x844 and re-test /signals, /analytics, /flow, /logs, /settings navigation from Home.
Re-run mobile UI regression after sidebar fix to confirm no overflow and route accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile accessibility regression: critical Home sidebar route button has zero-size bounds at mobile viewport, blocking expected navigation path.
Secrets hygiene risk: backend .env currently contains multiple sensitive third-party tokens; ensure they are not committed in source control and rotate if exposed.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated demo sessions and TESTONLY observer payloads via API during automated tests; no broad DB deletion performed.
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains no credentials; no auth flow testing was required for this task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 27/27 pytest tests passed against external URL, including new demo-ledger edge cases (idempotency, 20-active cap, pending minute, reset archive, concurrent withdraw safety). Desktop Home/Workspace/Trade flows passed with screenshots. Mobile overflow checks passed on Home/Signals/Trade, but Home sidebar route button has zero-size bounding box and is not directly clickable in automation.
rca of the issue: Repro: open Home at 390x844, target [data-testid='nav-signals-button']; Playwright click fails with not visible. DOM inspection shows element style visible but bounding rect width/height = 0, indicating layout/collapse of the sidebar interactive area under mobile breakpoints. Mitigation: adjust mobile CSS/layout for sidebar/nav buttons or provide an alternate always-clickable mobile nav entrypoint for workspace routes.
